_note: Scheduled recurring macro/data-release events mapped to MCX contracts. Complementary to impact-map.json (ad-hoc geopolitical narrative KB, loaded into brief-writing prompts) — this file is NOT fed into brief generation, it is a display-layer data source for /calendar, TapeMovers, and UpcomingEventsForCommodity only. consensus_field is reserved/unused on every entry — never scrape consensus estimates from third-party calendars (ToS risk, product decision). Rule-based weekly entries (cadence_type: 'rule_based') have next_release_utc kept current by scripts/refresh-event-calendar.mjs. Irregular-cadence entries (cadence_type: 'manual') have next_release_utc manually seeded and need periodic manual refresh against each source's official calendar — treat any date more than ~6 weeks stale as suspect. MCX expiry entries (cadence_type: 'mcx_expiry') derive from data/kite-instruments.json and go stale every contract rollover — refresh alongside that file.

events.name: EIA Natural Gas Storage Report
events.description_educational: Weekly change in US natural gas storage — the single largest recurring weekly volatility event for MCX Natural Gas, which tracks Henry Hub via USD/INR.

events.name: EIA Weekly Petroleum Status Report
events.description_educational: Weekly change in US commercial crude oil inventories — the most-watched recurring US supply/demand signal for MCX Crude, alongside API's Tuesday-evening estimate.

events.name: API Crude Inventories (industry estimate)
events.description_educational: American Petroleum Institute's own weekly estimate of US crude stock changes, released the evening before the official EIA figure — often moves MCX Crude in the Wednesday-morning IST session ahead of the EIA number.

events.name: OPEC+ / JMMC Meeting
events.description_educational: OPEC+ production-quota decisions directly set the supply backdrop for Brent/WTI, which MCX Crude tracks via USD/INR — historically the single largest scheduled (non-geopolitical-shock) driver of crude volatility.

events.name: US Consumer Price Index (CPI)
events.description_educational: US inflation prints shape Fed rate-path expectations, which move real yields and the dollar — the two primary transmission channels into MCX Gold and Silver.

events.name: FOMC Rate Decision + Press Conference
events.description_educational: The Fed's rate decision and forward guidance move US real yields and the dollar — the dominant macro driver for MCX Gold and Silver, with secondary effects on Copper and Crude via broad risk appetite.

events.name: US Non-Farm Payrolls (NFP)
events.description_educational: The monthly US jobs report is a key Fed-policy input — a labor market that cools faster than expected raises rate-cut odds, typically supportive for gold via lower real yields.

events.name: China Official PMI (NBS)
events.description_educational: China's official manufacturing PMI is a headline read on industrial demand — the single largest external demand signal for base metals (Copper, Aluminium, Zinc) given China's share of global consumption.

events.name: China Caixin Manufacturing PMI
events.description_educational: Caixin's PMI skews toward smaller/export-facing manufacturers, complementing the official NBS PMI — divergence between the two is itself a watched signal for base-metals demand momentum.

events.name: USDA WASDE Report
events.description_educational: USDA's World Agricultural Supply and Demand Estimates cover cotton and the broader vegetable-oil complex, with indirect linkage to CPO/edible-oil pricing dynamics tracked in India's agri-commodity space.

events.name: MPOB Malaysian Palm Oil Stocks
events.description_educational: Malaysia's monthly palm oil stock/production/export data is the primary benchmark for the vegetable-oil complex globally, with a secondary read-through to India's edible-oil import economics.

events.name: Baker Hughes US Rig Count
events.description_educational: A weekly proxy for future US drilling activity and supply growth — a slower-moving, lower-impact signal than inventory reports, but relevant context for medium-term crude/gas supply trajectory.

events.name: NOAA Weather Outlook (HDD/CDD)
events.description_educational: Heating/cooling degree-day forecasts drive near-term US natural gas demand expectations — during peak summer cooling or winter heating season, weather forecast shifts can rival storage-report volatility for Natural Gas.

events.name: India CPI (Retail Inflation)
events.description_educational: India's retail inflation print shapes RBI policy expectations and rupee sentiment — MCX Gold, quoted in INR, carries a currency-translation sensitivity to India-specific macro data on top of USD-gold moves.

events.name: India WPI (Wholesale Inflation)
events.description_educational: Wholesale price data offers a secondary, producer-side read on Indian inflation, complementing CPI in shaping RBI's policy stance and, in turn, INR direction.

events.name: RBI Monetary Policy Committee Decision
events.description_educational: RBI's repo-rate decision and INR-management stance directly affect USD/INR — since MCX Gold and Crude are INR-denominated, rupee moves around MPC decisions show up mechanically in both contracts even without any change in underlying USD prices.

events.name: CFTC Commitment of Traders (COT) Report
events.description_educational: A weekly snapshot of futures positioning by trader category (commercial, managed money, etc.) on the international benchmark contracts — context on how crowded a positioning is, not a signal of future direction.

events.name: MCX Gold Contract Expiry
events.description_educational: Last trading day for the current MCX Gold futures contract — open positions must be closed or rolled to the next contract before expiry; liquidity and spreads can widen in the final sessions.

events.name: MCX Silver Contract Expiry
events.description_educational: Last trading day for the current MCX Silver futures contract before rollover to the next contract month.

events.name: MCX Crude Oil Contract Expiry
events.description_educational: Last trading day for the current MCX Crude Oil futures contract — crude expires ahead of the physical delivery month and rolls monthly, more frequently than metals.

events.name: MCX Copper Contract Expiry
events.description_educational: Last trading day for the current MCX Copper futures contract before rollover to the next contract month.

events.name: MCX Natural Gas Contract Expiry
events.description_educational: Last trading day for the current MCX Natural Gas futures contract — this contract rolls monthly, aligned closely with the Henry Hub futures calendar.

events.name: MCX Zinc Contract Expiry
events.description_educational: Last trading day for the current MCX Zinc futures contract before rollover to the next contract month.

events.name: MCX Lead Contract Expiry
events.description_educational: Last trading day for the current MCX Lead futures contract before rollover to the next contract month.

events.name: MCX Aluminium Contract Expiry
events.description_educational: Last trading day for the current MCX Aluminium futures contract before rollover to the next contract month.

events.name: MCX Nickel Contract Expiry
events.description_educational: Last trading day for the current MCX Nickel futures contract before rollover to the next contract month.
